citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:52am on August
4, 2026. The inspector contacted the licensee on arrival to the facility via phone call. The licensee answered indicating
she was unavailable. A facility representative was also not available to assist with an inspection. Failure to provide access
to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide
access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
